categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the in vitro diagnostics (IVD) industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of diagnostic reagents and instruments. It covers multiple technology platforms including immunodiagnostics (colloidal gold, fluorescence, flow cytometry), molecular diagnostics (PCR, FISH), biochemical diagnostics, and animal health products such as vaccines and diagnostic reagents. The business is structured into human medical diagnostics and animal health sectors, with a full industry chain from biological raw materials to third-party independent testing laboratories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include gene recombination, monoclonal and polyclonal antibody production, PCR amplification, colloidal gold preparation, fluorescence immunoassay, chemiluminescence, flow cytometry with liquid chip technology, and molecular diagnostics including nucleic acid amplification and fluorescent in situ hybridization. The company also employs cell factory production processes for animal vaccines and advanced manufacturing techniques such as automated production lines for POCT devices. It integrates digital and AI technologies in its R&D and production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves hospitals, clinical laboratories, third-party testing institutions, retail pharmacy chains, and veterinary markets globally. Its products target infectious diseases, drug testing, tumor markers, cardiovascular markers, prenatal screening, blood glucose monitoring, autoimmune diseases, inflammation, genetic diseases, allergens, and animal health diagnostics. Major markets include professional medical institutions and home self-testing consumers, as well as veterinary and pet health sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with production and R&D bases in China (Anji, Hangzhou, Nanjing, Chengdu, Hainan, Shanghai), the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, and the Philippines. It actively expands in North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, and the Belt and Road countries. It has established localized production and sales platforms in the US and Europe to mitigate trade risks and enhance market responsiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IVD supply chain, encompassing biological raw material production, diagnostic reagent manufacturing, diagnostic instrument production, and third-party clinical testing services. It also extends upstream by producing key biological raw materials such as antigens, antibodies, enzymes, and probes, aiming for vertical integration and reducing reliance on imports.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include global and localized R&D innovation, digital transformation, and expansion of multi-technology platforms (immunodiagnostics, molecular diagnostics, flow cytometry). The company emphasizes development of POCT products, multi-pathogen detection, animal health diagnostics, and vaccine production. It invests heavily in clinical registration, regulatory approvals (FDA, CE, NMPA), and advanced technologies like gene sequencing, nucleic acid mass spectrometry, microfluidics, and AI-assisted diagnostics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of diagnostic reagents, instruments, and animal vaccines. The company uses a combination of direct sales and distribution channels, including proprietary brands and ODM sales. It also derives income from third-party clinical testing services and strategic acquisitions that expand its product portfolio and market reach.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading Chinese IVD enterprise with a dual focus on human medical and animal health diagnostics. It competes with global giants like Roche, Abbott, Danaher, and Siemens in high-end markets, while leveraging cost advantages and policy support to expand in mid-to-low-end segments. It is among the few Chinese firms with comprehensive multi-platform capabilities and global localized production, holding a strong export presence in over 120 countries.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 828 million, with a slight year-over-year increase. However, it experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 529 million, reflecting increased costs from acquisitions, R&D, and asset impairments. The company maintains total assets around RMB 8.1 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D (over 35% of revenue). It is in a growth and transformation phase, expanding global footprint and product lines despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a comprehensive, vertically integrated IVD product portfolio with proprietary core technologies across multiple diagnostic platforms, enabling high-quality, cost-effective solutions. Its unique dual-track strategy in human and animal diagnostics, combined with global localized production and regulatory certifications (FDA De Novo, CLIA, IVDR), provides competitive advantages. The integration of digital innovation, AI, and multi-pathogen detection enhances product differentiation and market responsiveness, supporting both professional and home testing needs.
